messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Seek emergency medical attention or call the Poison Help line at 1-800-222-1222.
The most common sign of hydroxyzine overdose is heavy sedation. Other reported signs include seizures (convulsions), stupor, nausea, and vomiting.
Overdose can also cause QT prolongation and Torsade de Pointes, so heart monitoring with an ECG is recommended.
There is no specific antidote for hydroxyzine overdose.
Triplet: ["hydroxyzine", "has overdose complication", "Torsade de Pointes"]

The relation 'has overdose complication' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug overdose may lead to the medical condition or physiological disturbance specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has overdose symptom': An overdose of the subject drug may cause the symptom specified by the object entity.
B. 'has serious side effect': The subject drug may cause the serious or potentially dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity that requires medical attention.
C. 'use with caution in': The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
D. 'has overdose instruction': In case of an overdose of the subject drug the patient should follow the instruction specified by the object entity.
E. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.
